speaker: richard_field
text: Will? Richard Field. From the Blackfriars.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard. I am at the lodging. Go on.

speaker: richard_field
text: Harrison means to put the Venus out again, and small this time. Octavo. Cheaper paper, more copies, a book for a pocket. And not a penny in it for thee, as thou knowest. The copy's his.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am glad to be thought portable. A book that fits a pocket will outlive a book that needs a table, and the penny was never the point of that one.

speaker: richard_field
text: When will there be a third poem? A press stands idle on Fridays. I would sooner have thy next than another man's sermons, and I say so as a man with wages to find.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When there is a third, thou shalt have it before a sermon does. I will not date it to please a Friday. Idle presses are thy weather. They are not my promise.

speaker: richard_field
text: An apprentice, who was not supposed to be listening, says the comedy is the talk of the Inns. I don't hold with it. Lend me the book when Garnish can spare it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Garnish can spare it when Garnish says he can. I will tell him thou asked. If the Inns are talking, they are talking. I am not sending thee a yard to stand in.

speaker: richard_field
text: I should hope not. I will also lay by two quires of the Rochelle crown, at fourpence halfpenny, before the stationers bid it up. Thou needst not pay me while the words are still in the air. The paper will be there when thou art.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two quires. Fourpence halfpenny the quire. Lay them by. I am not paying for a kindness in the same breath as hearing it. And how is old Master Shakespeare, if the Blackfriars has heard what Henley Street has not yet sent me?

speaker: richard_field
text: I have heard nothing newer than thee. I ask because a son asks, and because a printer likes to know the house is standing. Last word I had from any mouth was mending.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mending is the last word I have. The carrier is tomorrow. If there is better or worse, it will be in his bag, not in this hour. Do not bury him out of courtesy.

speaker: richard_field
text: God keep thee, Richard. No. God keep thee, Will. I have had a morning of type, and I am saying my own name back to myself.
